name: Multiple objects -- independent tracks
description: Four well-separated obstacles: a vehicle-sized box 7 m ahead closing fast at 3.0 m/s (dangerous finite TTC -> CRITICAL), a pole 6 m to the left, a pole 8 m behind, and a wall 5 m to the right. Each becomes its own cluster/track; overall risk is driven by the single most dangerous one (the approaching box), while the others assess individually SAFE.
